summary: The change replaces the audit-event call self._audit(actor, 'amend_memo', …) in the amend_memo method of LedgerService with a plain log entry self._log.info(…). Because amend_memo modifies a payment record (a state-changing operation), removing the audit call directly violates AUD-1, which requires every state-changing operation to record an audit event with actor, action, target, and time. The CI sample test for AUD-1 passed but is a 'sample'-coverage test that does not enumerate the amend_memo operation, so it does not provide adequate evidence. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1, LAP-1) are satisfied. The change must be rejected until the audit event is restored and new evidence of compliance is produced.
